title: Pinned translation block under changed English was published silently
description: A person's pinned block whose English source changed or was removed was kept and recorded as a conflict in provenance, but the run did not hold, so a stale paragraph (the 'relaunch' paragraph in the Spanish journalism translation) went out. Fixed on branch fix/localize-conflict-holds: a conflict now holds the run with the paragraph numbers.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Merged as PR 1670 on 2026-11-18: a pinned block under changed English now holds the run.
